context:
Goal: the Hand screen's end-of-day list ships and tells the truth.
Problem (rule): you chose to keep the list as is when I told you no saved field could be added, but that was wrong, and a new saved field is your call because it changes the saved data.
Based on (read): the house rule for changing what the app saves allows a new optional, defaulted field if it touches five places in the app; the restore-time stamp you approved already adds a field this way.
Based on (read): today the list keys off one last-changed date per card, so a card you only reduced today with One fewer shows as checked in today.
Departs from: main saves no per-check-in date — option c adds a check-in date per envelope so the list shows only real check-ins.
Waiting on: your answer; the local mailaudit session holds the known-gap record and keeps the other end-of-day fixes moving.
